snippet.title: Apathema - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Cursed to repair the inner organs of The Chasm, you fight to uncover the secrets of your existence and end a self-devouring cycle of Apathy. Apathema is a grunge fantasy turn-based RPG, inspired by God Husk, Baroque, and King's Field. Apathema is coming soon to PC (Steam).
